measurement_note: Size is P = n!, the number of possible permutation states. Every tier enables all prefix lengths and starts at a state with maximum distance from the ascending target for that n, forcing breadth-first search through a substantial portion of the legal graph. A correct BFS that stores visited states in a list instead of a hash set pays a linear membership scan for each generated state and therefore grows asymptotically beyond the required O(P*q*n) traversal.
